children: Overview
Hong Kong auto parts maker's half-year sales rose 1% from prior year
Net profit attributable to shareholders fell 59% for the half-year
Profitability impacted by price competition, cost inflation, and operational challenges
Outlook
Company says automotive sector faces softening demand and intense price competition
Johnson Electric to focus on maintaining market share and targeted price reductions in mature product lines
Company to continue capital investments in automation and productivity improvements
Johnson Electric expects adjusted EBITA margins to remain at mid-single-digit levels in H2 FY26/27
Result Drivers
PRICE COMPETITION - Co said intense price competition, especially from China-based manufacturers, weighed on profitability
COST INFLATION - Higher raw material, repair, and maintenance costs, as well as temporary labor for new product ramp-ups, increased production expenses
FOREX IMPACT - Profitability was hurt by the non-recurrence of substantial foreign exchange gains recorded in the prior year
